meta.name: baoyu-diagram
meta.description: Create professional, dark-themed SVG diagrams of any type — architecture diagrams, flowcharts, sequence diagrams, structural diagrams, mind maps, timelines, illustrative/conceptual diagrams, and more. Use this skill whenever the user asks for any kind of technical or conceptual diagram, visualization of a system, process flow, data flow, component relationship, network topology, decision tree, org chart, state machine, or any visual representation of structure/logic/process. Also trigger when the user says "画个图" "画一个架构图" "diagram" "flowchart" "sequence diagram" "draw me a ..." or uploads content and asks to visualize it. Output is always a standalone .svg file.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任何系统或流程自动生成专业深色SVG图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速把复杂结构或流程变成清晰图表
copy.tagline_en: Generate professional dark-themed SVG diagrams from any system or process
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn complex structures or processes into clear diagrams

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的描述生成深色主题的专业 SVG 图表，包括架构图、流程图、时序图、思维导图等，并输出独立的 .svg 文件。
howto.when: 当你要求画任何技术或概念图表，或说出“画个图”“diagram”“flowchart”等关键词，或上传内容要求可视化时触发。

say.text: 画一个微服务架构图，包含 API 网关、服务注册和数据库。
say.note: Claude 会生成对应的架构 SVG 图。

say.text: 帮我画一个用户登录的流程图。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含决策节点的流程图。

say.text: 把这段代码的类关系画成结构图。
say.note: Claude 会解析代码并生成类图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate professional dark-themed SVG diagrams of any type — architecture, flowchart, sequence, mind map, etc. — and output a standalone .svg file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for any technical or conceptual diagram, say keywords like "diagram" or "flowchart", or upload content to visualize.

say_en.text: Draw a microservice architecture with API gateway, service registry, and database.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the corresponding architecture SVG.

say_en.text: Create a flowchart for user login.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a flowchart with decision nodes.

say_en.text: Visualize the class relationships in this code as a structural diagram.
say_en.note: Claude will parse the code and generate a class diagram.
